title: ProgressDialog::_update_ui() allows re-entrant Main::iteration(), crashing editor when @tool plugin calls save_scene() from _process()
body:
**Note to maintainers:** This is not an AI slop issue..  I'm the lead maintainer on the 8,000 star Unity-MCP repo. I do use LLMs to build (like many engineers nowadays), but I also make sure changes are minimal, follow project culture, and well tested. I rebuilt Godot with the fix and tested it thoroughly.  Just thought I'd let you know -- at unity-mcp, we get a ton of slop too, so anyway, hello from a real human!

### Tested versions

Reproducible on 4.6.2-stable (official, macOS arm64). Not tested on other platforms but the code path is platform-independent.

### System information

macOS 26.3.1, Apple M1 Max, Godot 4.6.2-stable (official)

### Issue description

Any `@tool` editor plugin that calls `EditorInterface.save_scene()` from `_process()` crashes the editor instantly with a stack overflow (SIGSEGV). The editor becomes completely unusable — it crashes on startup as soon as the plugin is enabled and a scene is open.

**What happens:** `_save_scene_with_preview()` calls `EditorProgress::step()`, which calls `ProgressDialog::_update_ui()` → `Main::iteration()`. This runs a full frame cycle including `NOTIFICATION_PROCESS` on all `@tool` nodes. If any plugin's `_process()` triggers another save, the call chain re-enters `_save_scene_with_preview()` → `_update_ui()` → `Main::iteration()` → `_process()` recursively with no guard. The stack overflows after ~1000 frames.

This is the same class of bug as #54864, which was fixed for `EditorFileSystem` in #73214 using a `prevent_recursive_process_hack` static bool guard. That PR's description explicitly notes `Main::iteration()` inside `ProgressDialog` as "the ill nature of EditorProgress" and that it "will have to be entirely rewritten."

In the wild, this affects any plugin that does non-trivial `_process()` work (WebSocket polling, HTTP requests, file I/O) that can indirectly trigger a save. The MRP below simplifies the repro by calling `save_scene()` directly from `_process()`.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project
2. Create a plugin with the MRP script below
3. Enable the plugin in Project Settings > Plugins
4. Open any scene
5. Editor crashes within seconds

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

`addons/reentrant_crash_repro/plugin.cfg`:
```ini
[plugin]
name="Reentrant _process() Crash Repro"
description="MRP: triggers re-entrant _process() via Main::iteration() in ProgressDialog during save"
author="dsarno"
version="1.0"
script="plugin.gd"
```

`addons/reentrant_crash_repro/plugin.gd`:
```gdscript
@tool
extends EditorPlugin

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if EditorInterface.get_edited_scene_root():
		EditorInterface.save_scene()
```
